text:
jason_sales: FYI OrionAI POC can't provision their Dedicated pool in asia-east1. Getting quota + zone mismatch. Need swarming help.
rya_cs: can you paste the CLI error?
jason_sales: from their console: 
```
ERROR: reservation failed (409) - quota_exceeded
{"error":"Requested GPUs (H100) exceed available quota in region asia-east1. requestedAffinity: 'asia-east1-a' not satisfiable"}
```
They wanted strict 'asia-east1-a' to reduce cross-rack latency.
kai_infra: sounds like two things: provider quota for H100 in asia-east1, and our reservation template uses "requestedAffinity" which is stricter than our usual soft preference.
sophia_engineer: do they need strict zone pin? their p95 requirement is ~30ms. usually region-level plus local preference hits that but depends on infra.
olivia_ops: infra-bot reports current pool usage: 
`infra-bot: [1840001180] capacity-allocator: 10/12 H100 in asia-east1 claimed; 0 free in asia-east1-a`
so if we can't move nodes around, strict pin will fail.
rya_cs: customer insists on AZ pin for compliance notes in their RFP. Also sent security questionnaire asking about host isolation and KMS. I asked for contact details for procurement.
kai_infra: quick mitigations: (1) create region reservation (asia-east1) without zone_affinity, add scheduler hint to prefer asia-east1-a, (2) temporarily swap 2 H100 from pre-prod pool if available, (3) escalate to capacity planning for strict AZ SLA.
jason_sales: how long would swap take? customer wants a demo tomorrow.
olivia_ops: reclaiming nodes from pre-prod could be 3-8h depending on approvals. If we need strict AZ SLA and buy/commit capacity it's 48-72h.
sophia_engineer: pricing note: soft-affinity = no price change. Strict AZ pinned reservation requires reserved hardware commitment -> finance will add surcharge and minimum term.
rya_cs: also note OrionAI asked if we can provide 1-year audit logs retention and KMS for keys. Any quick confirmation?
kai_infra: yes we support KMS integration and configurable audit retention. 1y is fine, we will include in contract.
infra-bot: [1840001265] reservation-req: ORN-req-9001 created, status: pending-capacity
jason_sales: customer provided reservation YAML: 
```
reservation:
  size: 6
  gpu: "H100"
  region: "asia-east1"
  affinity:
    type: "zone"
    zone: "asia-east1-a"
  term: "1m"
```
kai_infra: that "type: zone" is the strict affinity flag. Ask them if they'd accept affinity.type: "prefer-zone" instead.
rya_cs: I'll ask and push procurement/pricing question. Can someone estimate ballpark delta if they want strict AZ?
sophia_engineer: estimate +15-30% per-node depending on term length. I'll cc finance for exact numbers.
olivia_ops: starting a transfer of 2 H100 from staging now (ticket OPS-3124). ETA ~5h.
infra-bot: [1840001350] capacity-allocator: transfer in-progress 2/2 H100 -> asia-east1 pool
jason_sales: I'll tell the customer: (A) We can push a region reservation with zone-preference for demo tomorrow if they accept soft-affinity; (B) If they require hard AZ pin we need to escalate and there's a price/lead-time impact. Also ask for procurement contact and whether they can accept temporary soft-affinity for the demo.
kai_infra: I'll monitor the transfer and update reservation request when nodes show available.
rya_cs: can we schedule a quick 20m call in 2h to confirm script and procurement ask?
sophia_engineer: yes I'll join along with kai.
jason_sales: scheduled — thanks everyone. Tagging OrionAI contact to confirm. :thumbsup:
